29 |     output.color = input.color * weights[i32(input.uv.x)]
   |                                          ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^ not known when the shader is built

   = note: the PICA200 can index with a constant, a `for` counter or one of two address registers, nothing computed
   = help: loop over the array with `for i in 0..<N`, or index with a constant
